name: bioRxiv
fits_reason: A complete computational article with methods and research results is required; the current paper's scoring-table/corpus conflict must be reconciled before representing that table as validated output.
ai_for_this_use: Allowed, but every use must be declared.
fee_route: No submission fee; live FAQ in author's browser.
preprint_rule: Use before another preprint server. If bioRxiv declines, arXiv remains a possible fallback. Do not plan successful arXiv posting followed by bioRxiv.

name: arXiv
fits_reason: A self-contained substantive research article is expected; similar submissions may need consolidation or versioning. Whether these two connected papers have sufficient distinct contribution remains editorial judgement, supported by the consumption/authoring split documented here.
fee_route: Free submission service; no publication charge.
preprint_rule: Fallback after bioRxiv decline or an alternative first choice. Current official moderation policy limits submitters to two new submissions per calendar month and three active submissions; replacements have a separate once-per-week limit after version 5.
